Dispositivo elettronico portatile

Any small battery-powered electronic item used by passengers, which may interfere with aircraft systems if not managed properly.

Definition

Any small battery-powered electronic item used by passengers, which may interfere with aircraft systems if not managed properly.

Operational example

Passengers are reminded to turn off all portable electronic devices during take-off and landing.
